resources.string: ScreenGarden turns the time you spend away from your phone into a small garden. Focus sessions and quiet days help it grow, and nothing here rushes you.
No account, no cloud, no internet permission. Your data is read and stored on this device. It leaves only when you choose to save a backup or a picture.
Android only shares screen time through Usage access. ScreenGarden reads it to draw your day and water your plants, and nothing is uploaded or shared.
Usage access is on. Thank you.
Without it screen time and your daily score are unavailable. You can still grow plants through focus sessions and grant access later.
A gentle nudge, if you want one
Reminders stay off by default. You can allow gentle nudges about your goals and app limits. Active focus sessions show a countdown with a stop action.
These are goals, not rules. You can change every one of them later in Settings.

A backup includes your screen time, app package names, garden, focus sessions, milestones, limits and settings. Choose a private destination. The file is not encrypted; nothing is uploaded automatically.
Merge adds missing records. Existing records, daily totals and settings stay. Past garden rewards are not repeated.
Replace removes your current records and restores the backup and its settings. Imported timers stay stopped. Android permission grants do not change.
Your current garden and history will be replaced. Save a backup first if you want to keep them. This cannot be undone here.
Backup restored. Your plants are safe and past rewards will not repeat.
Could not read this backup. Choose a valid ScreenGarden backup up to 32 MB. Unsupported versions and damaged files leave your data unchanged.
Could not save the backup. Choose a writable destination and try again.
Restore could not finish. Stop any focus session and try again. If history was restored but settings could not be saved, reopen ScreenGarden to finish the pending settings update.
A restored settings update could not finish. Free some device storage, then try again.
